// TEMPORARY capture script (not committed to superbee-hosted): records the `bundles.create.v1`
// golden exchanges (`POST /sync/v1/bundle-create`) the superbee OSS CLI fake is checked against.
// To run it, copy lines 1-291 of superbee-hosted `test/sync-v1-bundle-create.test.ts` (its imports
// and its `fixture`, `bundle` and `json` helpers) into `test/zz-capture.test.ts`, append this file,
// and run `CAPTURE_OUT=<dir> npx tsx --test --test-name-pattern "capture bundles.create.v1" test/zz-capture.test.ts`.
// It drives the real gateway app (`createApp`) with real token verification and Miniflare D1 and
// R2; only the identity issuer is a fixture. Delete the copy afterwards.
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const OUT = process.env.CAPTURE_OUT!;
const GRAMMAR = ["content-type", "x-superbee-write-settled"];
const ids = {
  created: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c1",
  taken: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c2",
  history: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c3",
  collision: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c4",
  tooMany: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c5",
  noWorkspace: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c6",
  limit: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c7",
  unavailable: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c8",
  unknown: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000c9",
  conflict: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-0000000000ca",
};

test("capture bundles.create.v1 golden exchanges", async (t) => {
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const index: any[] = [];
  const record = async (f: any, name: string, description: string, rows: string[], body: unknown, requestId: string | null, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
    const requestHeaders: Record<string, string> = { "content-type": "application/json" };
    if (requestId !== null) requestHeaders["x-superbee-write-request"] = requestId;
    const text = JSON.stringify(body);
    const response: Response = await f.sync("bundle-create", text, { requestId, ...extra });
    const responseBody = await response.text();
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const h of GRAMMAR) {
      const v = response.headers.get(h);
      if (v !== null) headers[h] = v;
    }
    writeFileSync(
      `${OUT}/${name}.json`,
      `${JSON.stringify({ name, description, route: "/sync/v1/bundle-create", rows, request: { method: "POST", headers: requestHeaders, body: text }, response: { status: response.status, headers, body: responseBody, truncated: false } }, null, 2)}\n`,
    );
    index.push({ name, file: `${name}.json`, route: "/sync/v1/bundle-create", rows, status: response.status });
  };
  const f = await fixture(t);
  const created = bundle("mine.notes");
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-created", "A person creates a bundle in their own workspace.", ["200 ok"], created, ids.created);
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-replay", "The same request again confirms the creation.", ["200 ok"], created, ids.created);
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-request-conflict", "The same request id with other contents.", ["200 request_conflict"], bundle("mine.notes", { name: "Other" }), ids.created);
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-bundle-exists", "Another request for an id that is held.", ["200 bundle_exists"], bundle("mine.notes"), ids.taken);
  const history = bundle("hist.notes", {
    history: [
      { documentId: "notes/alpha", label: `imported:git/${"a".repeat(40)}`, author: "Ada <ada@example.com>", authoredAt: "2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z", frontmatter: { type: "Note", title: "Alpha" }, body: "Alpha v0.\n" },
    ],
  });
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-history", "Created with one imported, unverified history row.", ["200 ok"], history, ids.history);
  const collision = bundle("coll.notes", { documents: [{ id: "notes/A", frontmatter: { type: "Note" }, body: "a" }, { id: "notes/a", frontmatter: { type: "Note" }, body: "b" }] });
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-document-id-collision", "Two paths that fold to one file.", ["200 document_id_collision"], collision, ids.collision);
  const tooMany = bundle("big.notes", { documents: Array.from({ length: 1001 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `n/d${i}`, frontmatter: { type: "Note" }, body: "x" })) });
  await record(f, "bundle-create-400-invalid-input", "Over the 1,000 document bound: the request schema refuses it.", ["400 invalid_input"], tooMany, ids.tooMany);
  await record(f, "bundle-create-200-workspace-not-found", "A workspace the person is not a member of.", ["200 workspace_not_found"], bundle("ws.notes", { workspace: "tenant:c" }), ids.noWorkspace);
  const limited = await fixture(t, { limit: 1 });
  await limited.sync("bundle-create", bundle("lim.one"));
  await record(limited, "bundle-create-429-limit", "The person's configured create limit is used up.", ["429 bundle_create_limit"], bundle("lim.two"), ids.limit);
  const readOnly = await fixture(t, { sync: '{"version":1}' });
  await record(readOnly, "bundle-create-200-unavailable", "Creation is off: sync writes are not enabled.", ["200 bundle_create_unavailable"], bundle("ro.notes"), ids.unavailable);
  let hook: ((sql: string) => Promise<void>) | undefined;
  const gated = await fixture(t, { storageGate: () => hook });
  let failed = 0;
  hook = async (sql) => {
    if (sql.includes("INSERT INTO sb_doc_heads") && failed === 0) {
      failed += 1;
      throw new Error("injected storage failure");
    }
  };
  await record(gated, "bundle-create-503-write-outcome-unknown", "A failure after the reservation: the outcome is unknown.", ["503 write_outcome_unknown"], bundle("resume.notes"), ids.unknown);
  hook = undefined;
  await record(gated, "bundle-create-200-resumed", "The same request again resumes and completes the creation.", ["200 ok"], bundle("resume.notes"), ids.unknown);
  writeFileSync(
    `${OUT}/index.json`,
    `${JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, description: "Golden bundles.create.v1 exchanges (POST /sync/v1/bundle-create) captured from the real hosted gateway app (createApp with the test/sync-v1-bundle-create.test.ts fixture: real bearer admission, the creation ledger, Miniflare D1 and R2; only the identity issuer is a fixture). Each file is one request and the exact answer bytes; response headers are limited to content-type and x-superbee-write-settled. See capture-bundle-create-exchanges.hosted.txt.", source: "Holaxis-ai/superbee-hosted 09e577e6", exchanges: index }, null, 2)}\n`,
  );
});
